# E0141: a schema or lens refers to something the lineage declares outside it

A schema reads something the lineage declares outside the schema: its name,
#LatestVersion, the joinSchema, the lenses or a helper field (reference rule
ref-lineage-meta). The schema writes the literal it wants.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
lin: {
	name: "ship"
	schemas: {
		"0": "0": {
			schema: {a: string, n: lin.name}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0141]: n in schema 0.0 refers to lin.name, which is declared in the lineage outside the schema
 --> lineage.cue:5:27
  |
5 |             schema: {a: string, n: lin.name}
  |                                    ^^^
  |
  = note: reference rule ref-lineage-meta
  = help: a schema may refer only to its own body and CUE's builtin packages
```
